weaknesses: Methodological novelty is limited. Combining task rewards with an adversarial data prior closely follows established approaches such as GAIL, SeqGAN, and AMP. The main baseline comparison is confounded: ReaLchords uses only Hooktheory and no entropy regularization, whereas GAPT uses three datasets and entropy regularization. Without KL/entropy sweeps or stronger diversity-preserving baselines, the claim that adversarial training is necessary is unsupported.

The evaluation does not adequately establish musical realism or reward-hacking mitigation. Diversity is measured exclusively using an encoder that also supplies the training reward, while note-in-chord ratio captures only a narrow aspect of harmonic quality. Independent diversity measures, direct naturalness assessments, and training-reward versus independent-quality curves are missing. The broader claims about reward hacking in generative sequence models exceed evidence from this single application.

Statistical support is incomplete. Tables 1 and 2 report no uncertainty or variability across policy-training seeds. The 12-person study reports significance only as p < 0.05, without exact p-values, paired-effect confidence intervals, or a stated multiple-comparison procedure. The live harmony improvement over ReaLchords is only 0.462 to 0.467, so its reliability and practical importance remain unclear.

The learned-partner experiment provides an important counterexample to the overall narrative: Online MLE exceeds GAPT on both harmony (0.650 versus 0.648) and diversity (18.071 versus 12.914). The explanation that the partner accommodates MLE is not experimentally tested. Evaluation with a single learned partner therefore offers limited evidence of robust co-adaptation.

Adaptation-speed and low-latency claims are insufficiently quantified. The deployed system uses four-beat lookahead and commitment horizons at 80 BPM, corresponding to three seconds. There are no measured end-to-end latency distributions or quantitative recovery-time comparisons; Figure 7 and subjective ratings do not fully characterize responsiveness under this buffering scheme.

Several reporting gaps impede reproduction. Reward normalization and individual penalty magnitudes are unspecified, and Appendix C.5 describes a contrastive-only coherence reward despite the ensemble described in Section 3.4. Section 4.4 defines Vendi Score as spectral entropy rather than its exponential, leaving the implemented metric unclear. The claimed code and checkpoint release is not linked in the manuscript.
